docText: Implicit baseline — any authenticated user can pay fees for their own applications
graphText: Implicit baseline — any authenticated user can pay fees for their own applications. Payments does not independently verify application ownership; the calling domain or UI is responsible for that check before invoking payment flows.

docText: District staff paying fees for multiple applications in their organization
graphText: District staff paying fees for multiple applications in their organization. ISD grant is transitive to constituent districts/buildings; District grant is transitive to constituent buildings. System validates all selected applications are in scope before initiation; if any is out of scope the entire bulk request is rejected.

docText: Implicit baseline — user can re-initiate after failure; each retry creates a new transaction
graphText: Implicit baseline — user can re-initiate after failure; each retry creates a new transaction. No dedicated retry endpoint exists: retry simply calls POST /payments/initiate again (pay:Op_InitiatePayment), which is gated by payments.transaction.initiate, not this permission — so this permission is never actually enforced by any modeled PermissionRequirement. A documented gap, not fabricated.
